page-organizations-enterprise-compare-de: Use these guides to move from an architectural question to a scoped, evidence-led decision.
page-organizations-enterprise-hero-descr: Global financial markets continue to rely on outdated, costly, and fragmented settlement systems that introduce operational risk, capital inefficiency, and reconciliation overhead.
Cross-border transactions remain slow and opaque, while legacy infrastructure limits programmability, transparency, and real-time auditability.
page-organizations-enterprise-meta-descr: The enterprise blockchain for tokenized assets, stablecoins and institutional finance. Compare Ethereum with private DLT and see production use cases.
page-organizations-enterprise-use-cases-: Open financial systems built on Ethereum. DeFi lets anyone lend, borrow, trade, and earn yield on their assets globally, and creates utility for tokenized assets.
Production-grade, open settlement network for tokenized assets, stablecoins, and financial infrastructure.
Layer 2s are customized blockchains built on top of Ethereum. Deployments can be open, or built for requirements like speed, brand, privacy, cost, and more.
Deploy on Ethereum's public Mainnet for global transparency, or use enterprise-grade privacy solutions for confidentiality and control.
Tokenize assets, like real estate, commodities, or bonds, while stablecoins are designed for steady value, often pegged to assets like USD or gold.
page-organizations-enterprise-why-compos: Ethereum supports an ecosystem of wallets, custodians, auditors, data providers, and scaling solutions used globally in production by institutions today.
page-organizations-enterprise-why-descri: Ethereum is an open, globally distributed settlement network that supports programmable financial activity. Unlike proprietary or permissioned systems, Ethereum is a neutral base layer, with no single operator, that institutions can build compliance-aware applications on.
page-organizations-enterprise-why-liquid: The leading platform for asset tokenization, with 67% of all tokenized assets deployed. Ethereum's DeFi ecosystem benefits from 10 years of network effects with its DeFi ecosystem being 8x larger than that of the next largest ecosystem.
page-organizations-enterprise-why-neutra: No single point of failure, no central coordinator, no pause button, no counterparty risk. Resilient to geopolitical, regulatory, and infrastructure-level risks.
page-organizations-enterprise-why-resili: Ethereum has maintained 10 years of uninterrupted uptime, including liveness through 15+ successful network upgrades. A diverse infrastructure set and open client ecosystem reduce infrastructure and single-operator risks.
